meta.title: Frankencoin for savers: from a bank account or a crypto wallet
meta.description: Save in Swiss francs at the protocol rate. Start from a bank transfer or from USDC, USDT or ETH, and see how saving in ZCHF differs from investing in FCS.

hero.title: A Swiss-franc account|that lives on-chain.
hero.subtitle: Whether you start from a bank account or a crypto wallet, ZCHF deposited in the savings module earns the protocol rate and stays in your own wallet.

paths.title: Two ways in
paths.subtitle: Either way, interest is paid only on ZCHF you deposit in the savings module, starting three days after the deposit. ZCHF sitting in a wallet earns nothing.

items.title: From a bank account
items.description: Send francs or euros by bank transfer to Mt Pelerin and receive ZCHF in your wallet with 0% fees. Then deposit it in the savings module.

items.title: From a crypto wallet
items.description: Swap USDC, USDT or ETH into ZCHF on CoW Swap, Curve or Uniswap. Then deposit it in the savings module.

compare.title: Save or invest?
compare.subtitle: Both start with ZCHF. One keeps you in francs; the other makes you a part-owner of the protocol.

rows.label: Purpose
rows.save: Keep Swiss francs and earn the savings rate on them.
rows.invest: Take a stake in the protocol's equity and governance.

rows.label: How returns arise
rows.save: The rate set by governance, paid out of borrowers' interest. It accrues continuously and can change.
rows.invest: The reference value follows the equity reserve, which grows with protocol income and shrinks with losses. The market price can differ from it and can fall.

cta.title: Open your franc account.
cta.body: Buy ZCHF by bank transfer or swap, deposit it in savings, withdraw whenever you like.
